entities.name: PMID:25100867
observations: Aoudjane et al. studied HBV sub-genotype A1 in HIV-positive Malawian adults starting stavudine/lamivudine/nevirapine, with 12-month virologic follow-up. doi:10.1093/cid/ciu630.

entities.name: High HBV replication Malawi
observations: In the cohort, 96% of HBeAg-positive participants had baseline HBV DNA >2,000 IU/mL; median baseline HBV DNA was 8.1 log10 IU/mL among those later acquiring resistance-associated mutations.

entities.name: HBV RAM emergence Malawi
observations: During first-line stavudine/lamivudine/nevirapine ART, 24/96 participants with available follow-up (25%) acquired HBV resistance-associated mutations; M204I was detected at 6 months in 17% by Sanger and 94% by deep sequencing among tested samples.
